FR-001.title: Compute one compass position per country per loaded save from applicable axes

FR-002.title: Include 14 named axes, exclude 3 military-doctrine axes from position calc

FR-003.title: Assign each included axis a fixed configurable placement angle in quadrant bands

FR-004.title: Normalize every applicable axis reading to a common signed scale

FR-005.title: Exclude not-yet-applicable axes from the calculation, never treat as zero

FR-006.title: Normalize summed position by count of applicable axes (mean vector)

FR-007.title: Render one dot per plottable country on a single 2D chart

FR-008.title: Auto-scale chart range to actual spread of computed positions

FR-009.title: Hover shows country identity and per-axis breakdown

FR-010.title: No permanent all-country labels on saves with 50+ countries

FR-011.title: User can choose dot-size metric (population or total development)

FR-012.title: Visually distinguish great-power status in default color mode

FR-013.title: Alternate color mode maps dot color to a single chosen axis

FR-015.title: Distinguish no-data countries from genuinely centrist countries

expectations: Building a dedicated radar chart for the 3 excluded military-doctrine axes is out of scope
Click-to-pin, country search/filter, and date-scrubbing across snapshots are out of scope for this feature
context: area: src/parser (raw save extraction) and schema.sql (no existing societal_values storage)
constraint: no living-specs config present in repo, skipped
intent: Plot every country in a loaded save as a dot on a 2D ideological compass derived from a vector-sum of 13 Societal Value axes

decisions.why: matches existing nation_history/province_good_production convention for per-entity flat-object save fields
decisions.rejected: wide columns on nations table; JSON column

decisions.decision: Drop the raw -999 sentinel at ingest time, never store it
decisions.why: matches existing asNumberOrNull-style filtering; a missing row IS the not-applicable state for every downstream consumer for free
decisions.rejected: storing -999 and requiring every query to filter it

decisions.decision: No gating-condition metadata modeled anywhere (no age/sphere table)
decisions.why: the raw -999 sentinel already tells us per-country whether an axis applies, regardless of the reason, resolving the latinization_vs_hellenization unknown without needing to reverse-engineer its trigger
decisions.rejected: hardcoding each axis unlock rule (age_of_absolutism, chinese sphere, etc.)

decisions.decision: Normalize raw -100..+100 values to -1.0..+1.0 only at the point of use (position computation), not in storage
decisions.why: Constitution IV: stored values should stay close to what the save actually contains

decisions.decision: First ECharts scatter series in the codebase, via the existing useEChartsInstance hook and LeaderboardChart-style option/tooltipFormatter pattern
decisions.why: no new charting dependency needed; symbolSize/itemStyle-as-function are standard ECharts capabilities

decisions.decision: Size/color toggles use the sidenav button-group pattern; color-by-axis sub-picker reuses GoodSelects filtered popover
decisions.why: matches existing precedent by list size (2-3 options vs ~16 axes)

decisions.decision: Negate the y component of the vector-sum projection (cos(angle), -sin(angle)) instead of (cos, sin)
decisions.why: user reported the quadrant orientation was flipped after seeing the live chart; this formula change is what actually makes Authoritarian Right land top-right, Market Libertarian bottom-right, State Collective top-left, Libertarian Collective bottom-left, rather than just relabeling corners
decisions.rejected: swapping which text string is placed in which screen corner without changing the underlying math

decisions.decision: Replace the 4 diagonal corner quadrant-name labels with 4 axis-end labels (top/bottom/left/right), each naming its 2 dominant Societal Value axes
decisions.why: explicit user request: label both ends of the x and y axes with what causes a country to go that direction, not an unexplained quadrant name
decisions.rejected: keeping corner labels and just fixing their text

decisions.decision: Force a shared, symmetric axis domain (min = -max, max = max, same value on both axes) computed from the actual plotted spread
decisions.why: user reported the compass was not centered; independent per-axis auto-scale does not guarantee the origin sits in the middle of the viewport
decisions.rejected: a fixed hardcoded domain, which would not adapt to the actual data spread

decisions.decision: Default the landing view to computeDefaultSelection (player-controlled countries, or a small fallback) plus AddCountryInput to add more, reusing the exact components Leaderboard and Markets already use
decisions.why: explicit user request to match the established pattern rather than invent a new one, and to avoid an unreadable all-countries default
decisions.rejected: a new bespoke country-selection component for this feature

decisions.decision: Color dots by the country's own real map color by default; drop the great-power color mode entirely; keep colorMode axis as the only alternate mode
decisions.why: two explicit user requests in sequence: tie dot color to country color and tag text, then remove great-power status from the feature altogether
decisions.rejected: keeping a great-power color mode alongside country color as a third option

decisions.decision: Fully reverted the great_power_manager ingestion: dropped the great_powers table, its query, its parsing in the version adapter, its fixture data, and its tests
decisions.why: explicit user request: get rid of the great power thing, we do not need that whatsoever
decisions.rejected: leaving the unused table/query in place for potential future use

plan.summary: Full normal-size plan: 2 new DB tables (long-format, no gating metadata needed since -999 is self-describing), 2 new Arrow queries, 1 new axis_config.json, 1 new Encyclopedia tab with a first-ever scatter chart built on existing conventions.
plan.key_finding: The raw -999 sentinel already resolves the spec open question about latinization_vs_hellenizations undocumented gating condition: we never need to know why an axis is inapplicable, only that it is.

tasks.summary: 18 tasks across Setup, Foundational, 3 story phases (P1 core scatter+hover, P2 size/color encoding, P3 quadrant overlay), and Polish; Page/Chart files evolve sequentially across stories rather than splitting per story.

implement.summary: Post-ship course correction applied after user reviewed the live feature: centered + symmetric chart, player-only default selection with AddCountryInput, country-color plus always-on tag labels, axis-end labels replacing quadrant corners, corrected quadrant orientation via a y-negation formula fix, and complete removal of the great-power feature (table, query, parser code, tests, fixture data). All 339 tests pass, tsc clean.

approach: Add two new long-format side tables (nation_societal_values, great_powers) to schema.sql, extend the 1.3.11 version adapter to populate them while dropping the -999 sentinel at ingest, expose them via two new Arrow queries, and build a new Encyclopedia tab with the codebase's first ECharts scatter chart, computing each country's compass position client-side from an axis_config.json angle table.
